listing.name: Tekken 5: Dark Resurrection Online — T5DR Online (TheWishin)
listing.summary: The project claims all offline modes at 60 FPS and online tests between two PCs. Broader hardware compatibility has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PSN NPUB30009 version 01.00 PKG of 619430240 bytes and its 16-byte RAP. Disc, European and Japanese editions are rejected.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release 1.1.4 launcher ZIP with its bundled compiler and runtime. Setup translates and builds from your own game files locally. Keep the resulting installed data with that runtime.

warnings: The project claims all offline modes at 60 FPS and online tests between two PCs. Broader hardware compatibility has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
